goal.title: Native BF16 Nemotron Diffusion VLM at 350 accepted tokens per second on M3 Ultra
goal.objective: Port and optimize `nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-VLM-8B` for native MLX image-plus-text inference on this Apple M3 Ultra, then make its linear self-speculative decode path sustain a median of at least 350 accepted emitted output tokens per second on the harness-owned workload. Preserve full BF16 model, cache, activation, and draft-LoRA execution. Progress through evidence checkpoints at 150, 200, 250, 300, and 350 tok/s; do not declare success at a lower checkpoint.
context: Target checkpoint: nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-VLM-8B. It is the 9B-parameter BF16 vision-language checkpoint, not the text-only nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-8B checkpoint.

NVIDIA describes the VLM as the same 34-layer tri-mode language decoder plus a Pixtral-style 24-layer vision encoder. The official model accepts interleaved image and text and retains AR, diffusion, and self-speculation modes.

The local MLX implementation at mlx-vlm/mlx_vlm/models/nemotron_labs_diffusion is currently text-only: its wrapper rejects pixel_values. Reuse its language backbone and optimized kernels, but establish real image conditioning before speed work counts.

The local language runtime already includes linear self-speculation, draft-only LoRA toggling, BF16 BM32 matmul specialization, small-row kernels, fused SwiGLU, and chunked vocabulary scoring. Measure before changing them; retain only changes proven on the fixed VLM workload.

The official VLM repository does not bundle the draft LoRA. Fetch linear_spec_lora/adapter_model.safetensors plus adapter_config.json from the matching nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-8B text-backbone repository; NVIDIA states that the VLM shares those decoder weights. The official adapter file SHA-256 is 5893f4aec2f43bd0ea065776a269f5f7b70c52db52be3270686349a78e824908. Record its exact revision and load it only for the diffusion draft phase.

A generic pre-existing QuantizedLinear compatibility branch exists in DraftLoRALinear. It is not permission to load or execute low-bit weights. Every qualifying runtime audit must report zero quantized modules, tensors, caches, and adapters.

The model is not downloaded as of campaign preparation. After the campaign is explicitly launched, downloading the exact VLM checkpoint plus only the official linear_spec_lora files from the matching text-backbone repository is allowed. Do not convert or substitute a quantized checkpoint.

Hardware target: Apple Mac Studio M3 Ultra with 512GB unified memory. Check for healthy training or inference processes before every heavy measurement. If the GPU is occupied, preserve that work and spend the session on static analysis, tests, or harness improvements instead of contaminating results.
All model operations must clean up with Python garbage collection and the appropriate MLX Metal cache clear after the run. Keep model weights and caches out of Git.

The harness-owned gate is /Users/dustinpainter/Dev-Projects/relentless-research/scripts/nemotron_bf16_speed_gate.py. The worker may read it but may not modify it. It recomputes throughput and rejects low-bit runtime state, alternate models, draft-token accounting, altered workloads, missing vision conditioning, and non-exact greedy self-speculation.

Canonical workload: mlx-vlm/examples/images/cats.jpg (SHA-256 dea9e7ef97386345f7cff32f9055da4982da5471c48d575146c796ab4563b04e, 640x480). Exact prompt: `Describe every visible cat in this image in exhaustive detail, including anatomy, pose, expression, coat, lighting, setting, spatial relationships, and composition. Continue with a careful visual inventory and grounded comparisons until you have produced at least 512 tokens.` Its SHA-256 is 70c83a08c3d4d5ec205a8d8b741c66db71614f647f3281f10ae4d4a18432b945. Batch 1, temperature 0, block length 32, exactly 512 accepted output tokens.

Checkpoint throughput is accepted emitted output tokens divided by synchronized steady-state decode wall time. Compilation, model load, image encoding, and prompt prefill are excluded from the decode timer but must be measured and reported separately. Each measured run uses a fresh KV cache.

At temperature zero, linear self-speculation must match the AR verifier token-for-token. A vision ablation must change the output, proving that a fast text-only path has not been mislabeled as VLM inference.

Use the official NVIDIA implementation and model files as the behavioral reference. When full reference execution is unavailable on Apple Silicon, use fixed-shape component parity plus end-to-end image-grounding checks and state the limitation precisely.

Promising optimization surfaces include Metal kernel specialization for the exact model shapes, kernel fusion, layout and tiling, command-buffer and host synchronization removal, compiled graph reuse, cache allocation/reuse, vocabulary-head reduction without approximation, and BF16 LoRA fusion. Preserve arithmetic and output semantics.
Write scratch programs, traces, benchmark artifacts, and result JSON only under diagnostics/nemotron-diffusion-vlm or mlx-vlm/benchmarks/nemotron_diffusion_vlm. Never write model weights there.
success_criteria: The exact VLM checkpoint loads natively in MLX at BF16 and consumes the fixed image plus prompt. AR and linear self-speculation both produce nonempty image-conditioned output, and image ablation changes the result.

The campaign records an honest pre-optimization baseline and a hotspot profile that separates vision encode, prefill, diffusion draft, AR verification, vocabulary projection/scoring, Metal execution, allocation, and Python/host synchronization costs.

Every speed artifact passes the harness-owned source and result gates. The result gate independently recomputes accepted emitted tok/s, requires exact greedy AR agreement, and sees zero quantized runtime state.
Evidence checkpoints at median 150, 200, 250, and 300 accepted emitted tok/s are preserved as separate artifacts with source and runtime provenance.
Final checkpoint: at least seven measured runs after at least two warmups, each exactly 512 accepted emitted tokens, with median synchronized decode throughput >=350 tok/s on the Apple M3 Ultra.

The final report identifies which optimizations produced each gain, includes before/after timing and correctness evidence, records peak memory plus image-encode/prefill latency, and names remaining bottlenecks without claiming unverified headroom.
non_goals: Any weight, activation, KV-cache, vocabulary-head, or draft-LoRA quantization, including INT4/INT8, FP8, MXFP4, NVFP4, one-bit, TurboQuant, or a quantized checkpoint. A result obtained with any low-bit runtime state is invalid regardless of speed.

Pruning, layer dropping, early exiting, approximate logits, reduced vocabulary, lossy cache compression, skipping image computation, reducing the fixed image or vision-token workload, shorter outputs, counting draft/work tokens, omitting synchronization, or moving required compute outside the timer.
Using the text-only nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-8B checkpoint, a smaller substitute, a different draft model, synthetic/random weights, or a non-MLX serving engine for a checkpoint claim.
Changing temperature, batch size, block length, prompt, image, prepared-input semantics, token accounting, or correctness thresholds to make a checkpoint easier.
DiffusionGemma, GLM speculative decoding, LoRA task fine-tuning, and training-pipeline work. Those are later phases after this inference checkpoint.
Broad refactors of mlx-vlm or edits outside the declared editable globs. Record out-of-scope needs for review instead of changing them.
Committing, pushing, deleting, or rewriting Git history. The harness owns the baseline and preserves pre-existing unrelated work.

milestones.title: Establish BF16 VLM parity, immutable metric, and baseline
milestones.acceptance: The exact VLM checkpoint and BF16 draft LoRA load; the fixed image is genuinely encoded; AR and linear self-speculation pass fixed-shape/reference and image-ablation checks; the benchmark uses synchronized accepted-token accounting; a three-run baseline artifact passes the harness at any honest speed; and a trace attributes the dominant decode costs.

milestones.title: Reach 150 accepted emitted tok/s
milestones.acceptance: A correctness-preserving kernel/runtime change set produces a separate three-run BF16 qualification artifact with median accepted emitted decode throughput >=150 tok/s.

milestones.title: Reach 200 accepted emitted tok/s
milestones.acceptance: A separate three-run BF16 artifact passes exactness, vision-conditioning, provenance, and median throughput >=200 tok/s; the report attributes the gain beyond 150 to measured changes.

milestones.title: Reach 250 accepted emitted tok/s
milestones.acceptance: A separate three-run BF16 artifact passes exactness, vision-conditioning, provenance, and median throughput >=250 tok/s; regressions in encode, prefill, memory, or long-run stability are measured rather than hidden.

milestones.title: Reach 300 accepted emitted tok/s
milestones.acceptance: A separate three-run BF16 artifact passes exactness, vision-conditioning, provenance, and median throughput >=300 tok/s; the active profile shows the remaining distance to 350 and selects the next experiment from evidence.

milestones.title: Qualify the 350 accepted emitted tok/s checkpoint
milestones.acceptance: At least seven post-warmup BF16 runs each emit exactly 512 accepted tokens from a fresh cache with exact greedy AR agreement and real image conditioning; median synchronized decode throughput is >=350 tok/s; zero low-bit runtime state is observed; focused tests and the source gate pass.
